name: Kodo Liver
summary: In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn needs Kodo Liver for a strange ale. The wandering brewmaster Chen Stormstout taught him to brew it.

sections.title: A Bizarre Brewing Reagent
sections.body: Kodos roam the Barrens, hunted by tauren and predators for their hides and meat. In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn blends a fresh Kodo Liver with thunderhawk saliva glands and lightning glands to make trogg ale. Chen Stormstout taught him the recipe, and Drohn says the brew has a potent kick for adventurous travelers. Its ingredients come from the wilds of central Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is a Kodo Liver used for?
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet uses Kodo Liver to make trogg ale. Chen Stormstout taught him the recipe.

faq.q: Which creatures yield a Kodo Liver?
faq.answer: Kodos in the Barrens yield Kodo Liver. They include common, wooly, lost, and greater kodos, as well as Lakota'mani and Brontus.

faq.q: Why would anyone put animal organs in ale?
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn follows the unusual recipes Chen Stormstout taught him. Raw organs such as Kodo Liver and elemental glands give trogg ale its kick and sharp flavor.

angles.text: Kodo meat feeds people across central Kalimdor, but Kodo Liver is considered too foul and pungent for ordinary cooking. Its use in Ratchet's trogg ale has made it notorious.
Tauren honor every part of the kodo they hunt. Even seasoned plainsrunners look askance at goblins and foreigners who make novelty ale from kodo innards in Ratchet.
